title: Mixing: Little Lamb Dragonfly by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

Wings’ first studio session of 1973 was for mixing the Red Rose Speedway song ‘Little Lamb Dragonfly’ on 8 January.

Studio engineer Alan Parsons made four stereo mixes, numbered RS1-RS4, the last of which was chosen by Paul McCartney for the album.

Page last updated: 26 November 2025
